pages.name: index
pages.title: Home | Fleet Services Agency
pages.heroMedia: industrial fleet vehicles parked in a modern business setting
pages.agentPageDescription: The homepage introduces Fleet Services Agency with a confident, business-focused first impression. Visitors quickly understand the company serves fleets and commercial clients, then move toward learning more or getting in touch. Tone: modern, dependable, and practical.
pages.agentInstructions:
Page purpose: The homepage promotes fleet services to local businesses with a modern industrial feel and clear calls to action.

Sections:
- HeroSplitSection: pure-static. Write a strong business-focused headline, concise supporting copy, and a primary CTA toward services or contact.
- BenefitsSection: pure-static. Present the main reasons businesses choose the agency; keep the benefits specific to fleet reliability, maintenance, and uptime.
- AboutImageSection: pure-static. Introduce the company briefly with a credibility-focused paragraph and an image caption or supporting text.
- ProcessSection: pure-static. Explain the service process in 3–4 simple steps; keep it practical and easy to scan.
- StatsSection: pure-static. Write short metric labels and supporting copy that reinforce trust, scale, and local expertise.
- CtaBannerSection: pure-static. Add a direct service-led CTA encouraging businesses to request a quote or speak with the team.

pages.name: about
pages.title: About | Fleet Services Agency
pages.heroMedia: subtle workshop or fleet operations imagery
pages.agentPageDescription: The About page builds credibility by explaining who the agency is, how it works, and what it values. It reassures business visitors that they are dealing with a capable, long-term partner. Tone: grounded, professional, and trustworthy.
pages.agentInstructions:
Page purpose: The about page tells the company story, builds trust, and explains the agency’s approach to fleet services.

Sections:
- HeroSplitSection: pure-static. Write an authoritative about-page headline and a short brand story subheadline.
- AboutImageSection: pure-static. Use this section to communicate values, team focus, or operational credibility; do not add unrelated marketing content.
- BenefitsSection: pure-static. Describe the company’s strengths, service standards, and reliability promise.
- ProcessSection: pure-static. Explain how the team works with business clients from initial contact through ongoing support.
- StatsSection: pure-static. Include credibility metrics, years in business, or service-area indicators in concise copy.
- CtaBannerSection: pure-static. Close with a simple CTA to contact the agency or review services.

pages.name: services
pages.title: Services | Fleet Services Agency
pages.heroMedia: clean industrial service environment with fleet maintenance context
pages.agentPageDescription: The Services page presents the agency’s commercial offerings in a clear, easy-to-scan way. Users come here to compare what is available and decide which support fits their fleet needs. Tone: efficient, direct, and solution-oriented.
pages.agentInstructions:
Page purpose: The services page outlines the agency’s fleet service offering for businesses and helps users choose the right support.

Sections:
- HeroSplitSection: pure-static. Write a service-led headline and a short explanation of who the services are for.
- BenefitsSection: pure-static. Summarize the key value of the service offering and why it matters for business fleets.
- ProcessSection: pure-static. Explain the service workflow clearly, emphasizing simplicity and dependable turnaround.
- ServicesGridSection: pure-static. Write service names, short descriptions, and concise supporting copy for each service card; keep everything focused on business fleet needs.
- StatsSection: pure-static. Add concise trust-building metrics relevant to fleet service performance.
- CtaBannerSection: pure-static. End with a strong quote/request CTA aimed at business decision-makers.

pages.name: service-detail
pages.title: Service Details | Fleet Services Agency
pages.heroMedia: detailed close-up of fleet service operations

sections.stateDescription: Receives item (service record resolved from the current route), loading, and error state from the page binding. Render the primary service details from item and use item.slug as the canonical related-item exclusion key when needed by child links.

Receives item (current service) and relatedItems (other service records from the same collection with the current item excluded). Must render only relatedItems and never include the current item identified by item.slug.

pages.agentPageDescription: The service detail page explains one offering in more depth for visitors who want specifics before reaching out. It supports decision-making by giving a focused, trustworthy view of the service. Tone: informative, precise, and reassuring.
pages.agentInstructions:
Page purpose: A detailed service page explaining one fleet service in depth, with related options and a contact prompt.

Sections:
- ServiceDetailSection: collection-bound. The service title, description, and detailed content come from the live service item. Write only labels, short introductory text, and any empty-state or supporting copy; do not invent service-specific facts.
- RelatedServicesSection: collection-bound. Related service cards come from live collection data. Write only the heading, short subtitle, and any empty-state text; do not write item details.
- CtaBannerSection: pure-static. Write a concise CTA encouraging businesses to request a quote or learn more.
- ContactSplitSection: pure-static. Provide contact-oriented headline, supportive copy, and form/help text; keep it professional and local-business focused.

pages.name: contact
pages.title: Contact | Fleet Services Agency
pages.heroMedia: simple business contact setting with industrial accents
pages.agentPageDescription: The Contact page gives businesses a direct route to start a conversation or request service. It should feel simple, responsive, and low-friction, encouraging inquiries from local commercial clients. Tone: welcoming, efficient, and action-focused.
pages.agentInstructions:
Page purpose: The contact page makes it easy for businesses to request fleet service information and get in touch.

Sections:
- MapSection: pure-static. Provide a local-service heading and short supporting text that introduces the service area or office location.
- StatsSection: pure-static. Add concise credibility or response-time metrics that support conversion.
- CtaBannerSection: pure-static. Write a direct prompt to contact the agency for a quote or consultation.
- ContactSplitSection: pure-static. Write the contact form labels, helper text, and submission prompt; keep the tone clear and businesslike.

pages.name: privacy
pages.title: Privacy Policy | Fleet Services Agency
pages.agentInstructions:

Sections:
- TextProseSection: pure-static. Write straightforward policy copy with clear headings and readable paragraphs; keep it legally appropriate and unambiguous.
